title: Slice Preparation and Blockface Imaging for Electrophysiology - Mouse
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be2gjgbw

steps.title: Load Tubing into Pump Head
steps.instruction: Install the appropriate tubing into the pump head based on the model and tubing size.

substeps.instruction: Select the correct tubing and locate the corresponding size tubing holder machined into the pump block (Model 77: A=1/4" ID, B=1/8" ID; Model 66: A=1/8" ID, B=1/16" ID).
Thread the tubing through the round scallop in the pump head.
Manually rotate the pump head while feeding the tubing around the moving head through the scallop.
Fasten the free end of the tubing into the second tubing holder, ensuring it is snug but not too tight.
Rotate the pump head manually for a few revolutions to verify free movement.

steps.title: Power On the Pump
steps.instruction: Initialize the device using the main power switch.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the main power switch located on the rear panel above the fuse holder.
Wait for the display to illuminate all LEDs and flash '0.0000'.
Press any key to stop the flashing and enable entries.

steps.title: Calibrate the Pump
steps.instruction: Calibrate the pump to match specific tubing and liquid conditions for accurate dispensing.

substeps.instruction: Load the pump with required tubing and liquid, then prime by pressing RUN (stop manually using the STOP key).
Press SET and CAL to enter Calibration mode ('ml/rev' will flash).

Enter the approximate calibration factor using the numerical keypad and press ENTER. (Approximate factors for 1/16" wall thickness: Pump 77 1/4"=5.85; Pump 77 1/8"=1.22; Pump 66 1/8"=0.88; Pump 66 1/16"=0.22).
Press SET and CAL again to select 'Calibration' mode, then press RUN.
Allow the pump to dispense until it stops automatically ('Run' light off, 'ml' flashing).
Accurately measure the dispensed volume (dispenses should be over 10 ml to minimize drop size error).
Enter the measured volume via the keypad and press ENTER to recalculate the calibration factor.
Press CAL to review the new calibration factor.

steps.title: Configure Flow Rate and Volume
steps.instruction: Set the operational parameters for the desired dispense.

substeps.instruction: Set Flow Rate: Press SET and RATE, enter the value in ml/minute using the keypad, and press ENTER.
Set Volume: Press SET and VOLUME, enter the volume to be dispensed in ml, and press ENTER.

steps.title: Select and Execute Pumping Mode
steps.instruction: Choose the operational mode and start the pump.

substeps.instruction: Press the MODE key to cycle through 'Pump', 'Dispense', or 'Batch' and stop on the required mode.
For Pump Mode (continuous): Press RUN/STOP to start; press again to pause or stop.
For Dispense Mode (set volume): Ensure RATE and VOLUME are set, then press RUN.

For Batch Mode (repetitive): Press SET and NUMBER to enter the number of dispenses (0 for infinite) and press ENTER. Press SET and INTERVAL to enter the time delay (Hours:Minutes:Seconds) and press ENTER. Press RUN to start.

steps.title: Configure Optional Accuracy Features
steps.instruction: Enable endpoint slowdown or anti-drip functions if required.

substeps.instruction: Endpoint Slowdown: Press SET and 2, toggle 'E ON' or 'E OFF', and press ENTER.
Anti-Drip: Press SET and 3, toggle 'AON' or 'AOFF', and press ENTER.
